You are at 85% (₹850,000 of ₹1,000,000). Crossing the limit without registration can lead to notices later. Starting on the GST portal now is usually calmer than reacting to a notice.

Ask GST Pulse what filing looks like: https://advisor
Start registration: https://portal
checklist: PAN of the business / proprietor
Bank account details (cancelled cheque or passbook)
Proof of principal place of business (electricity bill / rent agreement)
Photograph of proprietor / authorised signatory
Aadhaar of authorised signatory (OTP verification on the GST portal)
